directory_match.match_basis: Exact postal/building and #01-05 unit overlap with official branch page. This establishes a current brand branch at the mall, not the branch availability of every listed dish.

existing_image_candidates.action: Do not append duplicates. Existing workbook rows already mark these as brand-level, review-only, not visually checked, and rights/reuse unconfirmed.

rights_limit: Official-hosted does not grant reuse permission. No reuse license was established in this pass; retain review-only/do not publish until authorized.
branch_availability_limit: These are brand-level Singapore menu images. The official menu warns menus vary by restaurant, so exact availability at CE13M19J000 is unconfirmed.
